rows.grounds: fused form of yuktam and eva

items.question: What characteristics render a chosen object suitable for ritual use?
premises: An object may have lines or dots
An object may have stains or similar marks
Absence of such marks indicates suitability
items.inference: An object free from lines, dots, stains, and the like is indeed suitable.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the suitable object depends on the preceding context
items.plain_english: Alternatively, what is free from lines, dots, stains, and the like is indeed suitable.
